sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: A yes/no question about the time is the same sentence with a question tone and a question mark: *Fél tíz van?* Agree with *Igen,* and the same time. To correct, say *Nem,* and the right time. To set the wrong time against the right one, use *nem … hanem*, as you did before: *Nem fél tíz, hanem negyed tíz van.* It works with parts of the day too: *Nem reggel, hanem este van.*

sections.title: Check and correct
rows: Nem fél tíz, hanem negyed tíz van.

items.english: Is it twelve o’clock at noon?
It is not morning but evening.

items.spanish: Hány óra van? – Háromnegyed hat van.
items.english: What time is it? – It is 5:45.

items.spanish: Nem negyed hat, hanem háromnegyed hat van.

sections.content: Answer *Hány óra van?* with a time only, such as *Fél tíz van.* Do not answer with *negyed óra*: that is a length of time, not a time on the clock.
